name: CUTE DOLPHIN BUBBLE MACHINE.
description:
Type: Bubble Gun

Materials: ABS Plastic

Includes: Bubble basin + 1 bottle of bubble solution

Color: Not specified

Function: Automatic bubble blowing

Battery: Requires 3 AA batteries (not included)

Gender: Unisex

Age Range: 2–4 years

Country of Origin: P.R.C.

Description:
Bring endless fun to your little ones with this cute dolphin bubble gun. Easy to use and automatic, it blows bubbles effortlessly for hours of play. Lightweight and safe, it’s perfect for children aged 2–4 years, making outdoor or bath time even more enjoyable.
